bullets: Added a Discord invite banner and link after Freebuff sign-in on every post-login surface.
Added arrow-key navigation so slash and mention menus now own Up/Down in non-empty drafts.
Added CPU detail probing that skips systeminformation calls when os.cpus() throws on Linux and Windows.
Added time zone validation in window label helpers with UTC fallback to prevent formatting crashes.
Added a 15-step limit and forced final answer for researcher-web to bound unbounded research loops.
Added a PR-intent keyword matcher and two new CLI partner placement slots above the input box and /review.
Added detection of Bun AVX2 crashes on Windows via stderr matching for plain exit code 3.
Added BYOK context window discovery so runs resolve real provider limits instead of compacting at the default.
Added logging data serializer support that converts Error objects to structured JSON with truncated stacks.
Changed the Freebuff house ad copy to describe usage in hours per day with tier name and daily total.
Fixed OpenRouter to Anthropic model ID mapping so dotted version ids no longer 404 at Anthropic endpoints.
Fixed Freebuff session gate errors to explain mid-run stops and re-admit a new session on refresh.
Raised the backend health alert paging threshold from 1,000,000 to 10,000,000 transactions behind.
Removed the per-referrer web referral cap constant with no other executable code changes.
